svg.title: Validation loss by training time
svg.desc: Validation post-net log-mel MSE for each of 5 seeds. Dots: checkpoint kept for the time budget. Source: runs/final_*/result.json, commit af156b3.
svg.text: Same runs against training time. Dots mark the checkpoint kept within the 828 s time budget.
L-BFGS takes about twice as long per step, so it gets about 200 steps inside the budget.
